template_definition.purpose: Give authors one form for a guide that explains or walks a reader through a stable operating procedure.
template_definition.responsibility: A guide owns how a reader reaches and checks one operating outcome; execution and recovery steps stay with runbooks and rules stay with policies.
non_goals: Executable recovery or release procedures, which belong to a runbook.
Normative rules and approvals, which belong to a policy or governance document.
Granting authority to run any command.
template_definition.applicability: Every operation/guide document under docs/05.operations/guides/ and its template.

positive: GDE-0010 passes the form tree, table, body-contract, author-prompt and residue checks.
A guide whose Steps table keeps the registered columns passes the document table check.
negative: A reordered, missing or extra Steps column fails BODY-TABLE-COLUMNS.
A Lifecycle Traceability table whose keys differ from the body contract fails REGISTRY_TABLE_BODY_CONTRACT.
A table section outside the form fails REGISTRY_TABLE_SECTION.
regression: The loaded guide profiles keep heading lists equal to the form H2 titles.
tests/test_common_form_tree.py asserts exactly the Guide form and definition in the repository registry.

migration.meaning_map: The SPEC-0169 meaning map moves each GDE-0010 sentence into its Purpose, Prerequisites, Procedure or Verification section without changing meaning; the Task records it.
migration.retained_history: Git history retains the previous six-section guide layout and its template.

columns.meaning: Order of the step in the procedure.
What the reader does at this step.
How the reader observes that the step worked.
Link to the Spec or Task that owns the guide lineage, or an N/A reason.
The outcome the guide gives its readers.
The system, workflow or concept the guide covers.
